claims.value: Experiments 1-4 map respectively to tumor, stroma, tumor-plus-stroma, and tumor-plus-stroma laser-capture regions.
claims.evidence: The deposited mapping workbook supplies the authoritative per-RAW tissue compartment; all 4 RAW basenames are covered exactly once.

claims.value: Q Exactive HF DDA-HCD with Trypsin/Lys-C and the deposited MaxQuant modification set.
claims.evidence: The MaxQuant configuration and summary provide enzyme, tolerances, and fixed/variable modifications; paper and PRIDE provide instrument and HCD acquisition.

limitations: The mixed-region runs contain human tumor and mouse stroma; because the template has a single organism cell, those rows use template-legal `not applicable` and retain the mixed composition in the matched tissue-compartment characteristic/factor.
The workbook calls 1-4 experiment numbers and does not establish donor-level independence; singleton tumor/stroma rows use replicate 1 and the two mixed-region experiments use replicates 1 and 2.

The v1.1 template has one cleavage-agent cell. Trypsin is encoded as the shared terminal specificity, while the deposited Trypsin/Lys-C mixture is preserved here as an explicit limitation and evidence claim.
The PRIDE title says HnSCC, but raw names and the linked primary paper identify cutaneous SCC; the publication/sample-supported disease label is used.
